description: Get detailed information about a specific entity by its slug ID. Returns name, type, aliases, description, related entities, and citation count.
name: entities.get

citationCount.description: Number of citations in the source index. A citation of a whole section counts once, so the entity's paragraph total can be higher.

seeAlso.description: Related entry names. An entity with citationCount 0 is a cross-reference stub: follow seeAlso to the entry that has the paragraphs.

sense.description: For a concept with a lowercase name: "special" when the papers coin the word or use it in their own sense, "ordinary" when they use it in its everyday sense. A reader app can leave ordinary words out of a list of terms. Null for other entries.

title: Get Entity
